reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets roughly doubled from ~600/month (Jun-Jul) to 1180-1260/month (Aug-Sep) and the surge persists (E-07). The majority of disputed bills (1785 of 3025, ~59%) carry an ACTUAL meter read rather than an ESTIMATED one (E-02), ruling out estimate-substitution-driven causes as the primary driver and indicating the dominant mechanism is a billing-side defect in the import/validation step that miscalculates bills from accepted actual reads (H-ACTUAL-READ-BILLING-ERROR, SUPPORTED). A secondary, smaller stream of disputes (1240 bills) is tied to ESTIMATED reads, consistent with a field route completion shortfall (0.88 vs 0.95 target, E-05).
